issue_asks: Support `[[Page Name|link text]]` in the wikilinks extension, rendering `link text` as the anchor text
The link must point exactly where `[[Page Name]]` points, honoring base_url, end_url, html_class, a custom build_url and the wiki_* meta-data overrides
Whitespace around the name or the text must not matter
If the text part is empty, use the page name as the text
Plain `[[Page Name]]` links must keep working unchanged

findings.problem: When a link has a label, the code builds the URL from the label instead of the page name. `label` becomes the piped text, and `build_url(label, ...)` then uses it, so `[[Page Name|text]]` points to the text's URL. That is not where `[[Page Name]]` points, which the issue explicitly requires. The fix is to keep the page name (`m.group(1).strip()`) for `build_url` and use the label only for `a.text`.
findings.evidence:
markdown.markdown('[[Installation Guide|see the install docs]]', extensions=['wikilinks']) -> '

see the install docs

' (expected href="/Installation_Guide/"). Likewise '[[ A B | text ]]' -> href="/text/" (expected "/A_B/").

findings.problem: The labelled-link test checks only the anchor text with `assertIn` and never checks the href. That is why it misses the wrong-URL bug. There are also no tests for whitespace trimming, an empty label, or the label working with base_url/end_url/html_class, a custom build_url, or the wiki_* meta overrides. The new test file also uses a custom `md_render` helper; the other tests use `assertMarkdownRenders`, and the existing wikilinks tests live in tests/test_extensions.py.
findings.evidence: test_piped_link_shows_label: self.assertIn('>see the install docs', html) — passes even though href is '/see_the_install_docs/'.

findings.problem: The extension's documentation (docs/extensions/wikilinks.md) and the changelog are not updated for the new syntax.
findings.evidence: The diff touches only wikilinks.py and adds one test file.

commands_run: python -c "import markdown; ... markdown.markdown('[[Installation Guide|see the install docs]]', extensions=['wikilinks']) ..."
reviewer.summary: Request changes: the main requirement of the issue is broken. The regex change is fine, and plain `[[Page]]` links and the empty-label fallback work. But for a labelled link, handleMatch passes the label text to build_url instead of the page name. So `[[Installation Guide|see the install docs]]` links to /see_the_install_docs/ instead of /Installation_Guide/. The new test checks only the anchor text, so it misses this. The full suite passes (1168 tests, 52 skipped). To fix: build the URL from `m.group(1).strip()` and use the trimmed label only for the anchor text. Add tests that check the full HTML, including the href, for: a labelled link, whitespace trimming, an empty label, the config options, a custom build_url, and the meta overrides. Ideally also update the extension's docs and the changelog.
